component.title: Calendar
component.purpose: Make date selection localized, constrained, keyboard-operable, and visually calm across selection modes.

states.description: A single date is selected in a localized month grid.
A complete range differentiates its start, interval, and end.
Several independent dates remain scannable and removable.
Unavailable dates remain oriented but cannot be selected.

claims.statement: The grid uses a roving tab stop and delegates arrow/Home/End movement to useRovingFocus.
Single, multiple, range, week, and month modes preserve explicit value semantics through onChange.
Minimum, maximum, and consumer disabled-date constraints use native disabled semantics and preserve calendar orientation.
The calendar remains legible and operable on narrow viewports and across declared compatible kits.
